blocks.text: Cloud computing ke bohat se faide hain, lekin is ke saath kuch implications (asar aur un se jure masle) bhi aate hain jin par sochna zaroori hai. Agle hisse chaar implications batate hain: data security, scalability aur resource management, cost (kharcha), aur compliance (laws aur rules maanna).

blocks.prompt: Is hisse mein cloud computing ke kaun se chaar implications bataye gaye hain?
blocks.explanation: Data security; scalability aur resource management; cost considerations (kharche ke pehlu); compliance aur regulatory issues (laws aur sarkari rules).

items: Cloud ke implications: security, resource management, kharcha, compliance.
